name: Torr2Jelly
description: TorrServer torrent streaming & Prowlarr/Torznab integration for Jellyfin
overview: Stream torrents instantly on Jellyfin without waiting for downloads. Features direct TorrServer streaming, Prowlarr search, and automated .strm library generation.

versions.changelog: Autonomous TorrServer configuration sync: background watchdog periodically monitors TorrServer settings every 60 seconds and auto-pushes disk cache (100GB) and Proton VPN forwarded peer port if server restarts or resets settings.
